marketNotes.text: Consumer shops (Alternate, Reichelt, Jacob, Future-X, TopTen, billiger.de offers) show prices incl. 19% VAT. B2B shops (Bechtle, Senetic, EDP, Böttcher AG) show net prices first; those are recorded with vatIncluded false.

No LTO-10 40 TB cartridge (Fujifilm 16978170, Quantum MR-A10MQN-01, IBM 40 TB) had a price at any German seller checked on 2026-09-23. Stor IT Back mentions 40/100 TB 'Premium' LTO-10 tapes, quote only.

No half-height LTO-10 drive is listed in Germany. The only LTO-10 drives with a price are full-height MagStor desktops at EDP: SAS EUR 21,000 net (recorded) and Thunderbolt 3/USB4 EUR 21,900 net (not SAS, omitted).
No new standalone LTO-6 drive with a price was found; sellers list only LTO-6 library drive kits or refurbished loader drives.
HPE P84142-B25 (external) and P77034-B25 (1U rackmount) are LTO-9 drive bundles that include 5 cartridges, per Bechtle's product text, so they sit above bare-drive prices.
Quantum sells each drive as bare (-BR), kit (-EY), SAS HBA bundle (-FZ) and 1U rackmount (TC-L83CN/TC-L93CN) SKUs; price gaps within a generation often come from the bundle, not the seller.

Galaxus, Cyberport, Conrad, Proshop, computeruniverse and Amazon.de block direct fetches. Their offers come from billiger.de price lists (seller as named in the offer, billiger.de URL); marketplace offers were skipped.

billiger.de shows Jacob and bueromarkt-ag.de at prices that differ from their own shops (Fujifilm LTO-9 at bueromarkt-ag.de: EUR 115.98 on billiger.de vs EUR 79.99 net on the shop), so only the shops' own pages were used for them.
evolt24 and etoh24 list single-cartridge titles at multi-pack prices (Quantum LTO-8 EUR 440.60, HPE LTO-8 EUR 533.29); omitted.
Jacob's search listing showed HPE BC023A at EUR 11,883.48 'Sofort lieferbar', but the product page said 'nicht verfügbar' with no price; omitted.
TopTen Storage lists a labeled HP LTO-7 WORM cartridge (C7977WL) at EUR 29.90; looks like a listing error, omitted.
Böttcher AG shows net quantity tiers (1, 5, 10 units); the 1-unit price is recorded. Its bot wall blocked the LTO-8, LTO-10 and WORM pages after a few requests.
Senetic marks reduced items with the EU 30-day lowest price (HPE BC022A LTO-8 internal drive: was EUR 9,100.22 gross, now EUR 5,542.89 gross), but most of its drives are out of stock and quote only.
backup-store.de is a parked domain for sale, not a shop.
